brief:
Israel's defence minister said the Israeli military will not withdraw from territory it occupies in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza "under no circumstances," according to Middle East Eye. The statement represents a hardline position on Israel's territorial holdings and signals the country's intention to maintain a sustained military presence across the three regions.

The defence minister's remarks come as Israel faces mounting international pressure to end military operations and withdraw from disputed areas. The comments follow recent military engagements in Lebanon and Syria, as well as the ongoing conflict in Gaza, where Israeli forces have maintained a significant presence for an extended period.

title: Israeli defence minister vows military will not leave occupied territories
